drafts.subject: Price query: invoice LIS-0003353 against PO 4500012118
drafts.body:
Hi S. Kowalski,

Invoice LIS-0003353 from Limeburners Industrial Supplies has a price higher than PO 4500012118 on line 1 (Deep groove bearing 6205-2RS). They billed $15.90/ea against the PO price of $14.80. That is +7.4%, or $66.00 over on the line, and it breaches our 2% per-line tolerance.

Could you please let me know whether the higher price was agreed with the vendor?

- If yes, please amend the PO price so we can release the invoice.
- If no, we will ask Limeburners for a credit note for the difference.

The invoice is on hold until we hear from you.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable

drafts.subject: Invoice LIS-0003353 (PO 4500012118): quantity billed exceeds quantity received
drafts.body:
Dear Accounts Team,

Thank you for invoice LIS-0003353 dated 9 September 2026 against our purchase order 4500012118.

On line 2 (Lithium grease EP2, 450 g), the invoice bills 48 ea, but our goods receipts show that 36 ea have been received. This leaves a shortfall of 12 ea, which is $117.00 ex GST.

Could you please issue a credit note for the 12 ea shortfall, quoting invoice number LIS-0003353? Once we receive it, we will pay for the quantity delivered. If the remaining 12 ea are still to be delivered, please let us know the expected delivery date and reinvoice them on dispatch.

Please contact us if you believe our records are incorrect.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
